verdict.rationale: The pack never documents generating or editing a Zap workflow from a natural-language prompt. The closest items are adjacent features: Zapier MCP runs individual actions described in plain language, Copilot helps create agents rather than workflows, and AI writes troubleshooting instructions. None of these is prompt-driven workflow authoring or editing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate or edit a workflow from a natural-language prompt
